title: AI Video Game Experiment
author: VoiceTraditional422
selftext:
What's up gang?



Earlier today I gave Claude Opus 5.5 a full design brief for a fantasy RPG called Ashes of Aether and told it to act as lead developer with minimal human intervention.



No engine choice. No architecture prescription. No handholding.



So far it has chosen its own stack, built the project as a web app, and is chewing through the first major implementation pass.



What I'm tracking:



* how much it can build autonomously
* how coherent the architecture remains
* how many human interventions it actually needs
* where it gets stuck



If this keeps getting as ridiculous as it currently looks, I am going to document the whole thing.



It's also ripping through tokens like they're going out of style, so I've started up a Patreon to help me offset costs of this experiment. I am not trying to make money off of this, but don't have an unlimited budget to rip through hundreds of millions of tokens. I'll post the link in a follow up if sub rules allow it and there's some shared interest in this project.
